product_name.quote: Policy Document Bharti AXA Life Wealth Maximizer

irdai_description_line.value: A Unit Linked, Non-Participating Individual Life Insurance Plan
irdai_description_line.quote: Bharti AXA Life Wealth Maximizer A Unit Linked, Non-Participating Individual Life Insurance Plan

maturity_age_max.quote: 75 years for Premium Payment Term of 5 years

premium_min_annual.quote: Rs 6,000/- p.a. for all PPT and PT options available

premium_max.value: no limit, subject to board-approved underwriting policy
premium_max.quote: No Limit, subject to Board Approved Underwriting Policy

sum_assured_rule.quote: Sum Assured is an assured amount used to calculate the Death Benefit. It is equal to the Annualized Premium*10.

premium_allocation_charge.quote: The allocation charge is as per the tables below: Policy Year % of Annualised Premium 1 2% 2 6% 3 6% 4 5.5% 5 5.5% 6 5.5% 7 4.5% 8 4.5% 9 3.5% 10 3.5%
premium_allocation_charge.note: refunded at 118% after the premium term

policy_administration_charge.value: 0.0625% of annualised premium per month, maximum Rs 500 per month
policy_administration_charge.quote: The monthly Policy Administration Charge is 0.0625% as a percentage of Annualized Premium.

fund_management_charge.quote: Growth Opportunities Plus Fund 1.35% per annum Grow Money Plus Fund 1.35% per annum Build India Fund 1.35% per annum Save’n’grow Money Fund 1.25% per annum
fund_management_charge.note: FMCs charged during the premium term are also refunded at 118%

mortality_charge.value: per 1000 sum at risk by attained age; full table published
mortality_charge.quote: Mortality Rates* Per 1000 sum at risk per annum

discontinuance_charge.value: IRDAI-cap table in the policy bond (lower of % of AP, % of fund value or a rupee cap in years 1-4; nil from year 5)
discontinuance_charge.quote: stipulated in ‘Charges’ section – Discontinuance charges of this
discontinuance_charge.note: table not re-read for this product

switching_charge.quote: any number of Switches in a Policy Year free of charge.

guarantee_charge.quote: There are no investment guarantees offered under this Policy.

any_charge_returned.value: 118% of all premium allocation, admin, mortality and fund management charges deducted during the premium term, refunded in equal parts over the 5 years after the premium term
any_charge_returned.quote: 118% of all charges (total amount of Premium Allocation Charge, Admin charge, Mortality Charge and Fund Management Charge) excluding any extra underwriting charge applicable during the Premium Payment Term will be returned.

death_benefit_formula.value: highest of: sum assured (10x AP) less partial withdrawals in the last 2 years; 105% of premiums paid; fund value
death_benefit_formula.quote: The Death Benefit will be highest of: 1. Sum Assured less all Partial Withdrawals* made during the two-year period immediately preceding the date of death of Life Assured. 2. 105% of all premiums paid as on date of death.

maturity_benefit.value: fund value; no investment guarantee; settlement option
maturity_benefit.quote: The Maturity Benefit will be equal to the Policy Fund Value as on the Maturity Date.

loyalty_additions.value: 0.20% of fund value at the end of each year after the premium term until maturity
loyalty_additions.quote: The Loyalty Additions are 0.20% of the Policy Fund Value as at end of each Policy Year.

return_of_mortality_charges.value: part of the 118% refund of charges
return_of_mortality_charges.quote: The applicable charges are refunded uniformly at the end of every policy year during the corresponding five Policy Years falling after the end of the Premium Payment Term.

return_of_premium_allocation_charges.value: part of the 118% refund of charges
return_of_premium_allocation_charges.quote: The applicable charges are refunded uniformly at the end of every policy year during the corresponding five Policy Years falling after the end of the Premium Payment Term.

return_of_policy_admin_charges.value: part of the 118% refund of charges
return_of_policy_admin_charges.quote: The applicable charges are refunded uniformly at the end of every policy year during the corresponding five Policy Years falling after the end of the Premium Payment Term.

other_additions.value: fund management charges are also refunded (part of the 118% refund)
other_additions.quote: 118% of all charges (total amount of Premium Allocation Charge, Admin charge, Mortality Charge and Fund Management Charge) excluding any extra underwriting charge applicable during the Premium Payment Term will be returned.

fund_switching.value: any number free; minimum 5% per fund
fund_switching.quote: any number of Switches in a Policy Year free of charge.

premium_redirection.quote: can be modified only after the first Policy Year by submitting the Investment Fund Allocation Instruction.

partial_withdrawals.value: after lock-in; minimum Rs 5,000; fund must stay at least 120% of AP
partial_withdrawals.quote: The minimum partial withdrawal limit is Rs 5,000.

systematic_withdrawal_plan.value: annual SWB from year 10, up to one AP a year
systematic_withdrawal_plan.quote: SWB will start from 10th policy year or thereafter;

settlement_option.value: up to 5 years after maturity; no withdrawals or switches; cover is the higher of fund value or 105% of premiums
settlement_option.quote: In case of the death of the Life Insured during the Settlement Period, the higher of Policy Fund Value as on date of intimation of death or 105% of Total Premiums Paid as on the date of death shall be payable

policy_loan.quote: 12. Loan There is no provision of loan on the Policy.

value.name: Dynamic Fund Allocation
value.mechanics: Grow Money Plus Fund moving to Steady Money Fund over the last 5 years

value.name: Systematic Transfer Plan
value.mechanics: Safe Money Fund to Grow Money Plus Fund monthly; annual mode only

auto_portfolio_strategies.quote: In case this strategy is chosen at inception, the 1st Premium and subsequent premiums will be allocated (after deducting Premium Allocation Charges) to Grow Money Plus Fund.

fund_count.value: 8 funds plus the Discontinued Policy Fund
fund_count.quote: The plan lets You choose from 2 investment strategies - Dynamic Fund Allocation and Systematic Transfer Plan along with multiple fund options basis the financial goals and risk- return potential.
fund_count.note: fund set from the policy bond FMC table

fund_list.quote: Growth Opportunities Plus Fund 1.35% per annum Grow Money Plus Fund 1.35% per annum Build India Fund 1.35% per annum Save’n’grow Money Fund 1.25% per annum

index_or_thematic_funds.value: Build India Fund (infrastructure), Emerging Equity Fund (mid cap); no index fund

riders_available.note: rider section not read for this product

lock_in_years.quote: Lock-in Period is a period of five years from the Date of Commencement of Risk.

discontinuance_rules.value: in lock-in: fund less discontinuance charge to the Discontinued Policy Fund, cover stops; after lock-in: reduced paid-up unless revived or withdrawn
discontinuance_rules.quote: Description of Benefits payable in Reduced Paid Up status

revival_period.value: 3 years from the first unpaid premium
revival_period.quote: Revival Period is the time of 3 years from the date of the first unpaid premium

fund information is a web page, not a document
